title: What It Really Costs to Own a Ram TRX

scenes.text: The new Ram TRX starts at about one hundred thousand dollars. Edmunds estimates that five years of owning the previous one costs one hundred two thousand, two hundred eight dollars. And the biggest line in that estimate is not the price of the truck, it is the fuel. This is what it really costs to own a Ram TRX, with every number sourced, and with the places where nobody has published one.
scenes.caption: WHAT IT REALLY COSTS TO OWN A RAM TRX

scenes.text: We read Edmunds, Kelley Blue Book, the Energy Information Administration, the federal recall database, tyre retailers, Ram's own releases, and several magazines. Edmunds and Kelley Blue Book are estimates, not receipts. Where we do the arithmetic, it is labelled as ours, and where there is no published number, we say so.
scenes.caption: SOURCES: EDMUNDS · KBB · EIA · NHTSA RECALLS · TYRE RETAILERS · RAM RELEASES · MAGAZINES · COMMUNITY FORUM (LABELLED) · OUR ARITHMETIC IS LABELLED

scenes.text: Start with the sticker, which has changed a lot. Ram's release for the first truck gave sixty-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-five dollars plus a sixteen ninety-five destination charge. By our arithmetic, that is seventy-one thousand, six hundred ninety dollars, or point nine years of the Census Bureau's median household income of eighty-three thousand, seven hundred thirty.
scenes.caption: 2021 TRX: $69,995 + $1,695 = $71,690 (RAM RELEASE; OUR SUM) · ÷ $83,730 MEDIAN HOUSEHOLD INCOME (CENSUS 2024) ≈ 0.86 YEARS (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: MotorTrend's comparison listed the twenty twenty-three base TRX at eighty-five thousand, seven hundred eighty-five. Motor1 listed the twenty twenty-four standard truck at ninety-seven thousand, seven hundred thirty, and the Final Edition at one hundred nineteen thousand, six hundred twenty with destination. By our arithmetic, those are one point zero, one point two and one point four years of median household income.
scenes.caption: 2023 BASE $85,785 (MOTORTREND) ≈ 1.02 YR · 2024 STANDARD $97,730 ≈ 1.17 YR · 2024 FINAL EDITION $119,620 ≈ 1.43 YR OF MEDIAN INCOME (MOTOR1; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: KBB confirms the Final Edition arithmetic: a starting price of one hundred seventeen thousand, six hundred twenty-five dollars plus a mandatory nineteen ninety-five destination fee. By our arithmetic, that totals one hundred nineteen thousand, six hundred twenty, which agrees with Motor1. It was limited to four thousand trucks and announced on the thirtieth of August twenty twenty-three.
scenes.caption: KBB: $117,625 + $1,995 DEST = $119,620 ✓ (OUR SUM) · LIMITED TO 4,000 · ANNOUNCED 30 AUG 2023 (KBB; MOTOR1)

scenes.text: The twenty twenty-seven truck starts at ninety-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-five dollars plus a twenty-five ninety-five destination charge, in Ram's release. The Drive and Motor1 report slightly different totals, one hundred two thousand, seven ninety and one hundred two thousand, two ninety. By our arithmetic, Ram's own total is one hundred two thousand, five hundred ninety, which is one point two years of median income.
scenes.caption: RAM: $99,995 + $2,595 = $102,590 (OUR SUM) · THE DRIVE $102,790 · MOTOR1 $102,290 · $102,590 ÷ $83,730 ≈ 1.23 YEARS (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Against the average new vehicle, fifty thousand, eighty-nine dollars in August twenty twenty-six according to Kelley Blue Book, the twenty twenty-seven TRX starts at about two times the average. By our arithmetic, the ninety-nine thousand, nine hundred ninety-five starting price is one point nine nine times the average, and the Final Edition was two point four times.
scenes.caption: $99,995 ÷ $50,089 = 1.99× · $119,620 ÷ $50,089 = 2.39× (KBB AUG 2026 AVERAGE; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Depreciation first, using Kelley Blue Book's twenty twenty-one TRX page. The current resale value is fifty-four thousand, five hundred dollars and the trade-in value forty-eight thousand. KBB says the truck lost thirteen thousand, seven hundred sixty-six dollars, or twenty percent, in the last three years. Those values are valid through the twenty-third of October twenty twenty-six.
scenes.caption: KBB 2021 TRX: RESALE $54,500 · TRADE-IN $48,000 · −$13,766 (20%) IN 3 YEARS · VALUES VALID THROUGH 23 OCT 2026

scenes.text: The yearly pattern is useful. KBB lists seven thousand, eight hundred nine for twenty twenty-three, fifty-seven sixty-seven for twenty twenty-four, forty-eight seventy-two for twenty twenty-five, and thirty-one twenty-seven for the current year so far. By our arithmetic, each year's loss is smaller than the one before. That is the normal shape of depreciation.
scenes.caption: KBB: 2023 $7,809 · 2024 $5,767 · 2025 $4,872 · NOW $3,127 (EACH SMALLER THAN THE LAST) (KBB; OUR OBSERVATION)

scenes.text: Compare the first sticker with today's resale. A base twenty twenty-one TRX at seventy-one thousand, six hundred ninety delivered, against fifty-four thousand, five hundred now. By our arithmetic, that is a loss of seventeen thousand, one hundred ninety dollars, or twenty-four percent. It is rough, since we do not know the trim of KBB's example, and Launch Edition trucks cost more.
scenes.caption: $71,690 − $54,500 = $17,190 = 24.0% (OUR ARITHMETIC; TRIM OF KBB EXAMPLE UNKNOWN; LAUNCH EDITION COST MORE)

scenes.text: Edmunds uses a different method. Its page for the twenty twenty-three TRX gives a total cash price of seventy-four thousand, seventy-eight dollars, based on the used private-party value, and five-year depreciation of twenty-one thousand, two hundred ninety-three. By our arithmetic, that is twenty-nine percent of that cash price, or about forty-two hundred fifty-nine dollars a year.
scenes.caption: EDMUNDS 2023 TRX: CASH PRICE $74,078 · 5-YR DEPRECIATION $21,293 = 28.7% = $4,259/YEAR (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Edmunds also shows a suggested price of seventy-five thousand, five hundred eighty-eight dollars for a used twenty twenty-four TRX, in a widget on its article about the TRX ending. By our arithmetic, against the ninety-seven thousand, seven hundred thirty standard price, that is a drop of twenty-two thousand, one hundred forty-two, or twenty-three percent. The widget has no date, so we treat it as a rough guide.
scenes.caption: EDMUNDS WIDGET (UNDATED): USED 2024 TRX $75,588 vs $97,730 NEW → −$22,142 = −22.7% (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Selling method matters. KBB lists private-party values for a good-condition truck of fifty-two thousand, six hundred twenty dollars, and a trade-in value of forty-seven thousand, two hundred fifty. By our arithmetic, selling privately instead of trading in is worth five thousand, three hundred seventy dollars, more than ten percent of the trade-in value.
scenes.caption: KBB GOOD CONDITION: PRIVATE $52,620 vs TRADE-IN $47,250 → $5,370 = 11.4% OF TRADE-IN (KBB; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Fuel is the line that surprises people. KBB lists the EPA rating of the TRX at ten miles per gallon in the city, fourteen on the highway and twelve combined. The Energy Information Administration says the average U.S. price of regular gasoline for the week of the nineteenth of October twenty twenty-six was four dollars, twenty-eight point four cents a gallon.
scenes.caption: EPA 10 CITY / 14 HWY / 12 COMBINED MPG (KBB) · EIA REGULAR GASOLINE, WEEK OF 19 OCT 2026: $4.284/GALLON

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, at twelve miles per gallon and four dollars, twenty-eight cents, each mile costs thirty-five point seven cents. At ten, it is forty-two point eight cents, and at fourteen, thirty point six. A hundred miles of mixed driving, at the combined rating, costs thirty-five dollars seventy. These are our calculations from the two published inputs.
scenes.caption: $4.284 ÷ 12 = $0.357/MI · ÷ 10 = $0.428 · ÷ 14 = $0.306 · 100 MI ≈ $35.70 (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Now the yearly cost, under assumptions we state. At twelve thousand miles a year, one thousand gallons, or four thousand, two hundred eighty-four dollars. At fifteen thousand, twelve hundred fifty gallons, or fifty-three fifty-five. At twenty thousand, sixteen sixty-seven gallons, or seven thousand, one hundred forty. The mileages are our assumptions, not figures from any source.
scenes.caption: 12,000 MI → 1,000 GAL → $4,284 · 15,000 MI → 1,250 GAL → $5,355 · 20,000 MI → 1,667 GAL → $7,140 (OUR ARITHMETIC; MILEAGES ARE ASSUMPTIONS)

scenes.text: Edmunds puts five-year fuel for the TRX at thirty-eight thousand, ninety-three dollars. By our arithmetic, that is seventy-six hundred eighteen dollars a year. At today's price, our calculation says that would need about twenty-one thousand, three hundred miles a year at twelve miles per gallon. Edmunds does not show its mileage or fuel price, so the difference may be either.
scenes.caption: $38,093 ÷ 5 = $7,619/YEAR → ÷ $4.284 = 1,778 GAL → × 12 = ~21,300 MI/YEAR (OUR ARITHMETIC) · EDMUNDS' ASSUMPTIONS NOT SHOWN

scenes.text: At fifteen thousand miles a year and today's price held constant, five years of fuel would be twenty-six thousand, seven hundred seventy-five dollars. That is our figure, not Edmunds'. It is eleven thousand, three hundred eighteen less than Edmunds' estimate. Even at our lower figure, fuel would be larger than the five-year insurance and repair costs added together.
scenes.caption: $5,355 × 5 = $26,775 (OUR ARITHMETIC; PRICE HELD CONSTANT) · EDMUNDS $38,093 − $26,775 = $11,318 · INSURANCE $7,815 + REPAIRS $3,160 = $10,975 < $26,775

scenes.text: Edmunds' five-year table for the TRX lists insurance at seven thousand, eight hundred fifteen dollars. By our arithmetic, that is fifteen hundred sixty-three dollars a year, or about one hundred thirty dollars a month. The page does not say where the driver lives, their age, or their record, which are the things that decide an insurance quote.
scenes.caption: EDMUNDS 5-YR INSURANCE $7,815 → $1,563/YEAR → ~$130/MONTH (OUR ARITHMETIC) · DRIVER PROFILE AND STATE NOT SHOWN

scenes.text: Maintenance is listed at eighty-five ninety-three, and repairs at thirty-one sixty. By our arithmetic, that is seventeen hundred nineteen dollars a year for maintenance and six hundred thirty-two for repairs. We note that Edmunds shows exactly the same repairs figure, thirty-one sixty, for the Ford Raptor R and the standard Raptor, which suggests a formula rather than a truck-specific measurement.
scenes.caption: MAINT $8,593 → $1,719/YEAR · REPAIRS $3,160 → $632/YEAR (OUR ARITHMETIC) · SAME $3,160 SHOWN FOR RAPTOR R AND RAPTOR (EDMUNDS) → LIKELY A FORMULA

scenes.text: Taxes and fees are eighty-two fifty-eight, and financing is fourteen thousand, nine hundred ninety-six. By our arithmetic, financing alone is about fifteen percent of the five-year total, and about twenty percent of the cash price. Edmunds does not show the loan rate or down payment, so this line depends heavily on assumptions we cannot see.
scenes.caption: TAX/FEES $8,258 · FINANCING $14,996 = 14.7% OF $102,208 · 20.2% OF $74,078 CASH PRICE (OUR ARITHMETIC) · RATE AND DOWN PAYMENT NOT SHOWN

scenes.text: Add the table back up. Depreciation, twenty-one thousand, two hundred ninety-three. Insurance, seventy-eight fifteen. Maintenance, eighty-five ninety-three. Repairs, thirty-one sixty. Fuel, thirty-eight ninety-three. Financing, fourteen nine ninety-six. Taxes and fees, eighty-two fifty-eight. By our arithmetic, that totals one hundred two thousand, two hundred eight, which matches Edmunds' total.
scenes.caption: $21,293 + $7,815 + $8,593 + $3,160 + $38,093 + $14,996 + $8,258 = $102,208 ✓ (EDMUNDS; OUR SUM)

scenes.text: Per year, that is twenty thousand, four hundred forty-two dollars. By our arithmetic, that is about seventeen hundred a month, or fifty-six dollars a day. If the driver covers fifteen thousand miles a year, our assumption, it is one dollar thirty-six a mile. These are Edmunds' estimates divided by our assumptions, so treat the per-mile figure as an illustration.
scenes.caption: $102,208 ÷ 5 = $20,442/YEAR ≈ $1,703/MONTH ≈ $56/DAY · ÷ 15,000 MI = $1.36/MI (OUR ARITHMETIC; MILEAGE ASSUMED)

scenes.text: For a sense of scale, the average new vehicle costs fifty thousand, eighty-nine dollars. By our arithmetic, the TRX's estimated five-year cost to own is two point zero four times that, and it is one point two two years of a median household's income. Those are comparisons of different things, a price against a cost, and we give them only for scale.
scenes.caption: $102,208 ÷ $50,089 = 2.04× · $102,208 ÷ $83,730 = 1.22 YEARS OF MEDIAN INCOME (OUR ARITHMETIC; A COST vs A PRICE: SCALE ONLY)

scenes.text: Tyres are a hidden cost on a truck with thirty-five-inch rubber. Ram's first release lists Goodyear Wrangler Territory all-terrains on eighteen-inch wheels. A tyre retailer, Tires Easy, lists the matching size, three twenty-five sixty-five eighteen, from one hundred ninety-seven dollars sixty per tyre for an unknown-brand all-terrain to four hundred sixty-two dollars twelve for a Goodyear Duratrac.
scenes.caption: SIZE LT325/65R18 · TIRES EASY LISTINGS: $197.60 (LANDGOLDEN A/T) TO $462.12 (GOODYEAR DURATRAC) PER TYRE · RAM ORIGINAL: GOODYEAR WRANGLER TERRITORY AT ON 18-IN WHEELS

scenes.text: The retailer's Goodyear Wrangler Territory R T, which is a different model from the Territory A T on the truck, is three hundred forty-three dollars five cents. By our arithmetic, a set of four is one thousand, three hundred seventy-two dollars twenty, and the cheapest listing's set is seven hundred ninety dollars forty. These exclude installation and a federal excise tax fee on some listings.
scenes.caption: TERRITORY RT $343.05 × 4 = $1,372.20 · CHEAPEST $197.60 × 4 = $790.40 (OUR ARITHMETIC) · EXCLUDES INSTALLATION; SOME LISTINGS ADD $13.60 FET · RT ≠ OEM AT MODEL

scenes.text: A community forum, which we treat as unverified, has a different picture. One poster in March twenty twenty-one said a dealer quoted a thousand dollars for each beadlock wheel, five hundred fifty for a tyre, and about forty for a sensor, or seven thousand, nine hundred ten dollars for a set of five without installation. Another poster, who said he was a Goodyear dealer, said the factory tyre cost him two hundred thirteen.
scenes.caption: FORUM (UNVERIFIED), MARCH 2021: WHEEL $1,000 · TYRE $550 · SENSOR ~$40 · SET OF 5 $7,910 · ANOTHER POSTER (SAID HE WAS A GOODYEAR DEALER): FACTORY TYRE $213 COST, $263 MOUNTED

scenes.text: Check the forum arithmetic. Five wheels at a thousand, five tyres at five fifty, and four sensors at forty make seven thousand, nine hundred ten, as the poster said. By our arithmetic, the tyres alone at five hundred fifty are twenty-seven hundred fifty for five. The two forum quotes differ by a factor of two, and we cannot verify either.
scenes.caption: 5×$1,000 + 5×$550 + 4×$40 = $7,910 ✓ (OUR SUM) · $550 vs $263 MOUNTED → 2.1× APART · COMMUNITY CLAIMS, UNVERIFIED

scenes.text: One warranty note: Tire Rack's page for the Wrangler Territory A T lists no treadwear warranty for any size. Tires Easy shows fifty to sixty thousand mile warranties for several cheaper brands. We did not find a published life for the original tyre on a TRX, so how often an owner buys a set is, in our sources, unknown.
scenes.caption: TIRE RACK: TERRITORY AT TREADWEAR WARRANTY 'NONE' · TIRES EASY: 50–60K-MILE WARRANTIES ON SOME CHEAPER BRANDS · TRX TYRE LIFE: NOT PUBLISHED IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Where does each part of Edmunds' total sit? By our arithmetic, fuel is thirty-seven percent, depreciation twenty-one, financing fifteen, maintenance eight, taxes and fees eight, insurance almost eight, and repairs three. Those add up to one hundred percent. The truck's price is only part of the story, and the part you pay at the pump is the biggest.
scenes.caption: FUEL 37.3% · DEPRECIATION 20.8% · FINANCING 14.7% · MAINTENANCE 8.4% · TAXES/FEES 8.1% · INSURANCE 7.6% · REPAIRS 3.1% = 100% OF $102,208 (EDMUNDS; OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Compare the TRX with the Raptor R line by line, from Edmunds. Insurance is three hundred forty-five dollars higher for the Ram, 4.6 percent more. Maintenance is seventeen hundred thirty lower, almost seventeen percent less. The Ford's estimate of ten thousand, three hundred twenty-three for maintenance is higher, but Edmunds does not explain why.
scenes.query: TRX vs Raptor R line items
scenes.caption: INSURANCE: TRX $7,815 vs R $7,470 (+$345, +4.6%) · MAINTENANCE: TRX $8,593 vs R $10,323 (−$1,730, −16.8%) (EDMUNDS; OUR ARITHMETIC) · REASON NOT GIVEN

scenes.text: Edmunds also lists the standard Raptor with the V6 at ninety-five thousand, two hundred sixty-five dollars over five years. By our arithmetic, the TRX costs six thousand, nine hundred forty-three more than that. Fuel accounts for most of it: twenty-eight thousand, five hundred eighty-five for the V6 against thirty-eight thousand, ninety-three for the TRX, a difference of nine thousand, five hundred eight.
scenes.caption: EDMUNDS STANDARD RAPTOR (V6) $95,265 vs TRX $102,208 → +$6,943 · FUEL $28,585 vs $38,093 → +$9,508 (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: What does twelve miles per gallon cost compared with sixteen, the combined rating Autoblog lists for the V6 Raptor? By our arithmetic, at fifteen thousand miles a year, that is one thousand, two hundred fifty gallons against nine hundred thirty-eight, a difference of three hundred twelve and a half gallons. At four dollars, twenty-eight cents, it is about thirteen hundred thirty-nine dollars a year.
scenes.caption: 15,000 MI: 12 MPG = 1,250 GAL · 16 MPG = 937.5 GAL → 312.5 GAL × $4.284 ≈ $1,339/YEAR (OUR ARITHMETIC; 16 MPG FROM AUTOBLOG; MILEAGE ASSUMED)

scenes.text: The fuel price is a swing factor. By our arithmetic, each one dollar change in the price of a gallon changes a TRX owner's yearly bill by twelve hundred fifty dollars, at fifteen thousand miles. Edmunds does not tell us the price it assumed, so a different price would change its five-year number by thousands.
scenes.caption: 15,000 MI ÷ 12 MPG = 1,250 GAL → $1.00/GAL = $1,250/YEAR; 5 YR = $6,250 (OUR ARITHMETIC; EDMUNDS' PRICE ASSUMPTION NOT SHOWN)

scenes.text: Taxes and fees are also worth a look. Edmunds lists eighty-two fifty-eight on a cash price of seventy-four thousand, seventy-eight. By our arithmetic, that is eleven point one percent. It depends on the state and county, and the page does not say which one it assumes, so a buyer in a low-tax state would see a smaller number.
scenes.caption: $8,258 ÷ $74,078 = 11.1% (OUR ARITHMETIC; LOCATION NOT STATED) · VARIES BY STATE

scenes.text: Destination charges have risen too. The first release listed sixteen ninety-five. The Final Edition carried nineteen ninety-five. Ram's twenty twenty-seven release lists twenty-five ninety-five, and The Drive reports twenty-seven ninety-five. By our arithmetic, Ram's figure is nine hundred dollars, or fifty-three percent, above the first.
scenes.caption: $1,695 (2020) → $1,995 (2023–24) → $2,595 (RAM 2027) / $2,795 (THE DRIVE) · $2,595 − $1,695 = $900 = +53.1% (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Options add more. MotorTrend's TRX cost eighty-five thousand, seven hundred eighty-five as a base truck and one hundred three thousand, nine hundred eighty as tested. By our arithmetic, the options added eighteen thousand, one hundred ninety-five dollars, or twenty-one percent. Motor1 estimated that matching a Raptor R's equipment would take about twenty thousand dollars in options.
scenes.caption: MOTORTREND TRX: $85,785 BASE → $103,980 AS TESTED = +$18,195 = +21.2% (OUR ARITHMETIC) · MOTOR1: ~$20,000 IN OPTIONS TO MATCH A RAPTOR R

scenes.text: Edmunds' cash price for the Raptor R is ninety-nine thousand, nine hundred seventy-nine dollars, against seventy-four thousand, seventy-eight for the TRX. By our arithmetic, that is a difference of twenty-five thousand, nine hundred one, or thirty-five percent of the TRX's price. But Edmunds' cash prices come from used values plus typical options, so they do not match the sticker comparison.
scenes.caption: EDMUNDS CASH PRICE: RAPTOR R $99,979 vs TRX $74,078 → +$25,901 = +35.0% (OUR ARITHMETIC; USED-VALUE-BASED, NOT STICKER)

scenes.text: There is also an environmental cost that Wikipedia records. The American Council for an Energy-Efficient Economy ranked the TRX the worst-performing mass-market vehicle for twenty twenty-one, twenty twenty-two and twenty twenty-three. That is not a cost to the owner's wallet. But it is a cost that the ranking says the truck carries, and it comes from the same twelve miles per gallon.
scenes.caption: ACEEE: 'WORST-PERFORMING MASS-MARKET VEHICLE' 2021, 2022, 2023 (WIKIPEDIA) · SAME 12 MPG COMBINED (KBB) · NOT A WALLET COST

scenes.text: Finally, one thing the TRX owners are paying for that we cannot price: the limited editions. The Final Edition was capped at four thousand trucks, and the Launch Edition at seven hundred two. Our sources have no resale data for either, so we cannot say whether those badges kept their value better than the standard truck.
scenes.caption: FINAL EDITION 4,000 · LAUNCH EDITION 702 (RAM; MOTOR1) · RESALE DATA FOR EITHER: NOT IN OUR SOURCES

scenes.text: Recalls do not cost the owner anything, but they say something about reliability. The federal safety database lists fifteen recalls for the twenty twenty-one Ram 1500, across all trims. By our reading of the list, none mention the TRX or the supercharged six point two litre engine by name. That is not the same as saying none of those trucks were included.
scenes.caption: NHTSA LIST FOR 2021 RAM 1500: 15 RECALLS, ALL TRIMS · NONE NAMES THE TRX OR THE SUPERCHARGED 6.2 · NOT PROOF THE TRX WAS EXCLUDED

scenes.text: They are mostly software and small parts. Four rearview-display recalls. A wrong-sized spare. Side-curtain airbags with the wrong gas amount. A brake pedal clip, with owners told not to drive until repaired. Tailgate strikers. A stability control software fault. A mirror glass. Two driver airbag recalls. And seat belt anchors in July twenty twenty-six. Two others apply to diesel and eTorque engines.
scenes.caption: NHTSA: REARVIEW DISPLAY ×4 (21V438, 21V918, 22V638, 23V059) · SPARE TYRE · SIDE AIR BAGS · BRAKE PEDAL CLIP (DO NOT DRIVE) · TAILGATE · ESC SOFTWARE · MIRROR · 2 DRIVER AIRBAGS · SEAT BELT ANCHORS (JULY 2026) · 2 FOR DIESEL/eTORQUE ENGINES

scenes.text: By our arithmetic, the fifteen recalls break down as five in twenty twenty-one, three in twenty twenty-two, two each in twenty twenty-three, twenty twenty-four and twenty twenty-five, and one in twenty twenty-six. That is a count of campaign records, not of defective trucks, and the database does not show how many TRXs each campaign covered.
scenes.caption: 2021: 5 · 2022: 3 · 2023: 2 · 2024: 2 · 2025: 2 · 2026: 1 = 15 (NHTSA LIST; OUR COUNT) · TRXs PER CAMPAIGN: NOT SHOWN

scenes.text: Build the picture under stated assumptions. A twenty twenty-three TRX bought at Edmunds' cash price of seventy-four thousand, seventy-eight dollars, driven fifteen thousand miles a year for five years, would cost, by our arithmetic using our own fuel figure, about ninety thousand, eight hundred ninety dollars. We subtract Edmunds' thirty-eight thousand, ninety-three of fuel from its total, leaving sixty-four thousand, one hundred fifteen, and add our twenty-six thousand, seven hundred seventy-five. It is our scenario, not a published estimate.
scenes.caption: $102,208 − $38,093 + $26,775 = $90,890 (OUR ARITHMETIC: EDMUNDS LINES WITH FUEL AT $4.284 × 15,000 MI × 5 YR ÷ 12 MPG)

scenes.text: Either way, the answer is of the same order. Between ninety and one hundred two thousand dollars over five years, with depreciation already inside the total. That is eighteen to twenty thousand dollars a year. By our arithmetic, at the low end, it is about twenty-two percent of a median household's annual income every year, for five years.
scenes.caption: $90,890–$102,208 OVER 5 YR → $18,178–$20,442/YEAR · $18,178 ÷ $83,730 = 21.7% OF MEDIAN HOUSEHOLD INCOME PER YEAR (OUR ARITHMETIC)

scenes.text: Compare it with the TRX's rival. In a separate video, we showed Edmunds' five-year figure for the Ford Raptor R at one hundred nineteen thousand, four hundred nineteen. By our arithmetic, the TRX is seventeen thousand, two hundred eleven cheaper, mostly because of depreciation, financing, and the purchase price, with identical fuel and repair lines in the two tables.
scenes.caption: EDMUNDS RAPTOR R $119,419 vs TRX $102,208 → $17,211 (OUR ARITHMETIC) · FUEL AND REPAIRS IDENTICAL IN BOTH TABLES (EDMUNDS)

scenes.text: And the new truck? We found no cost-to-own table for the twenty twenty-seven TRX. It is more powerful, seven hundred seventy-seven horsepower against seven hundred two, and Ram has not published a fuel economy figure in the sources we read. So we can say the sticker has risen, but we cannot say the running costs have.
scenes.caption: NO COST-TO-OWN OR EPA FIGURES FOUND FOR THE 2027 TRX · 777 HP vs 702 HP · STICKER ~$99,995 START (RAM)

scenes.text: What is missing. Ram's own service price list for the TRX. A real owner's annual bill. The tyre life of the original tyres. An EPA rating for the twenty twenty-seven truck. A recall list specific to the TRX. And what Edmunds assumed for mileage, fuel price and financing, which decides the largest lines in its table.
scenes.caption: NOT IN OUR SOURCES: RAM SERVICE PRICE LIST · REAL OWNER BILLS · ORIGINAL TYRE LIFE · 2027 EPA RATING · TRX-SPECIFIC RECALL LIST · EDMUNDS' MILEAGE/FUEL/FINANCING ASSUMPTIONS
scenes.chapter: What our sources do not say

scenes.text: So the honest answer is a range, built from estimates. About ninety to one hundred two thousand dollars over five years, with fuel as the largest single line and the purchase price second, if you count depreciation. If you own a TRX, or have a published bill, share it in the comments, and we will update the description.
scenes.caption: RANGE: ~$90,900–$102,200 / 5 YR (OUR ARITHMETIC FROM EDMUNDS + EIA + KBB) · FUEL IS THE LARGEST LINE (EDMUNDS)

scenes.text: What is the most you have paid to fill up a truck? Tell us in the comments. In the other videos of this series, we reveal two things you did not know about the TRX, compare it with the Raptor R, and tell why Ram killed it. Our twenty twenty-seven Truck Buyer's Guide is linked in the description. Subscribe to Pickup Reality.
scenes.caption: SUBSCRIBE: PICKUP REALITY
